panels.scene: DANA walking down a leafy street with a phone at her ear, relaxed, curious.
dialogue: What are you working on this week?
panels.caption: Ask about a project.

panels.scene: WALT at the kitchen table with a chess set, phone beside him, explaining with a raised finger, green kettle on the stove.
dialogue: Come here, I will show you.
panels.caption: Ask them to teach you.

panels.scene: DANA on a bench in the park, phone at her ear, smiling, a coffee beside her.
dialogue: The bus driver sang today. Badly.
panels.caption: Share one small thing.
